decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09 (radio and CMMS agree; likely repair 13:20). The stope holds 260 t at 16.5 g/t, about 138 oz, the richest ore in the mine. Central is truck-limited and its stockpile has room (297 of 450 t), so the gain comes from swapping 16.5 g/t ore in for ~7 g/t ore. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.4 oz/h, and arrives in 0.48 h. LH-10 would arrive about 10:20 but is in preventive maintenance until 10:00. The critical-path loader LH-09 stays put. About 7 h x 30 t/h is ~200 t, worth ~60 oz, less ~3 oz of development cost.
